question: The first unified Asian Games were held in:
solution:
The correct answer is __**New Delhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• ​The **First Asian Games** was the official name for the **1951 Asian Games.**
 
• From **March 4 to March 11, 1951, New Delhi, India**, hosted a multisport tournament.
 
• The Games received names like** First Asiad and 1951 Asiad.**
 
• A **total of 57 events **from eight sports and disciplines featured **489 athletes from 11 Asian National Olympic Committees**.
 
• The **Asian Games Federation** was originally founded in **Delhi on February 13th, 1949**.
 
• **Delhi** has been selected as the **inaugural Asian Games** host city by a unanimous vote.
 
• With** 24 gold medals** and **60 total medals **earned,** Japanese **competitors led the way.
 
• **51 total medals** were won by India, with **15 **of them being gold. 
 
• In a medal table, it came in **second place.**
 
• The** second** Asian Games were held in the year **1954 in Manila, Philippines.**
 
• From then onwards, the games were organized **once in four years.**
